separability.definition: best-direction area under the ROC curve between the two members of a pair, per feature; 0.5 is no separation and 1.0 is complete

readings.auc_window_mean: the mean of the 50 records of a window
readings.auc_window_sd: the standard deviation across those 50 records

packets_per_row_method.Number: the Number column read back on its original scale, per class
packets_per_row_method.indicator: the smallest packet count for which every value of every per-packet indicator column that varies is a multiple of one over that count
